responsibility: Implements SuperH’s common option-handling layer by defining SH-specific optimization defaults and translating the many architecture-selection switches (-m1, -m2, -m2a, -m4a-single-only, etc.) into canonical MASK_ARCH selections stored in gcc_options. This file is the shared front end for SH CPU/FPU variant choice and optimization policy, separate from the backend code that emits SH instructions.
